summary: The root همر (hmr) primarily means to pour out, like water or tears. It can also refer to drawing out all the milk from an udder, giving generously from one's property, or speaking voluminously.
lane: 1 هَمَرَهُ ذ , (S, A, K,) aor. هَمُرَ (S, K) and هَمِرَ , (K,) inf. n. هَمْرٌ , (S,) He, or it, poured it; out or forth; (S, A, K;) namely, water, (S, TA,) and tears, and rain, and the like. (TA.) -b2- هَمَرَ مَا فِى الضَّرْعِ He drew forth all the milk that was in the udder. (S, K.) -b3- هَمَرَ لَهُ مِنْ مَالِهِ (assumed tropical:) He gave to him of his property. (S, K.) -b4- هَمَرَ الكَلَامَ , (K,) or فى كَلَامِهِ , (A,) aor. هَمُرَ , inf. n. هَمْرٌ : (TA;) and بِالكَلَامِ ; (S;) (tropical:) He talked much. (K.) -A2- هَمَرَ , intrans.: see 7. in two places.

headwords.def: (S, A, K,) aor. هَمُرَ (S, K) and هَمِرَ, (K,) inf. n. هَمْرٌ, (S,) He, or it, poured it; out or forth; (S, A, K;) namely, water, (S, TA,) and tears, and rain, and the like. (TA.) هَمَرَ مَا فِى الضَّرْعِ He drew forth all the milk that was in the udder. (S, K.) هَمَرَ لَهُ مِنْ مَالِهِ (assumed tropical:) He gave to him of his property. (S, K.) هَمَرَ الكَلَامَ, (K,) or فى كَلَامِهِ, (A,) aor. هَمُرَ, inf. n. هَمْرٌ: (TA;) and بِالكَلَامِ; (S;) (tropical:) He talked much.

It poured; poured out or forth; (K;) said of rain, and of tears; (TA;) as also, (K,) aor. هَمِرَ, inf. n. هُمُورٌ; (TA;) [and so, app.,, q. v.:] it flowed; said of water, (S, K,) of rain, and of tears; like انهمل: (TA:) and in like manner, عَيْنُهُ بِالدَّمْعِ His eye flowed with tears; as also هَمَلَتْ. (A.) انهمر بالكلام: see 1.
: see 7. (tropical:) He (a horse) ran (S, K, TA) like a torrent. (TA.)
A fall of rain. (K.) (tropical:) Angry speech. (Sgh, L, K.)

A cloud pouring forth much rain; as also. (K.) Applied to a man, (S,) (tropical:) Loquacious, garrulous; babbling; a great talker; a babbler; or nonsensical, irrational, foolish, or delirious, in his talk; as also and (S, K) and. (Sgh, K.) And مِهْمَرٌ (tropical:) An orator copious in speech. (A, TA) And, applied to a woman, (tropical:) Clamorous; (K, TA:) abounding in talk or speech, like a pouring torrent. (TA.)
Pouring rain, and tears; as also. (TA.) See also هَمَّارٌ.
: see هَمَّارٌ; the former, in two places.
: see هَمَّارٌ; the former, in two places.
: see هَمِرٌ: and see also هَمَّارٌ.

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
